utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the eighth of June. Hope your weekend plans survived the weather. Mine mostly involved standing under a gazebo pretending it wasn't raining.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sounds lovely compared with the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Started Monday with hot water that vaguely remembers a coffee bean.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the premium setting, that is.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Someone's got a new car in the car park, though. Very shiny. Parked miles from everyone else, naturally.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Give it a week. It'll have the same coating of dust as the rest of ours.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the car park appreciation society. Finished bits first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the 11kV board last night. That's done, not another job for this shift.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, you're talking about the repair that was on the previous list?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the one. Finished last night.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the IM1 on Tuesday. Last Tuesday, obviously. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the turbine one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—came all the way back, rather than sitting a bit low?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, back on its own. Just passing on what I saw, not raising a new job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I still can't get to the GT1 Compressor Section until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There isn't a window available at the moment. That's still the blocker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, then, not something we're agreeing to get done today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the CV01 is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cancelled outright, rather than moved to a different slot?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, cancelled. Nothing to allocate against that shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you sort the training records for the new starters, Monday, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The records, yeah? Not delivering any more training, just sorting the records.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, just the records. Monday, but whenever you get a chance around the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort the training records for the new starters Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer today? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't take that sign-off today, sorry. Haven't got the availability for that as well as the plant-side work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Grace, can you take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer instead? Today, and it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that off Marcus. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer today, urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just so I've heard it properly, that's the sign-off we're talking about, not a repair package?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. The lock-out tag-out sign-off, that's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, the plant-side one for you: grease and check the bearings on the boiler feed pump. Monday, please. Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that I can take. I'll grease and check the bearings on the boiler feed pump Monday. Understood, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, audio clipped for a second. That was the boiler feed pump?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The boiler feed pump, yes. Bearings, grease and check.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're on permits, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the GT2 next Tuesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Next Tuesday for the permit to work and isolation for the GT2, yes?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, next Tuesday. I'll take both parts, permit to work and isolation. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, separate from the cancelled shutdown. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll do a site visit at Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds with the contractor this morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's you, Sarah, at Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds with the contractor?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, me. This morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's the line 2 robot as well—the jam and the sensors. We haven't put a name against that yet.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus Hale. Both clearing the jam and checking the sensors on the line 2 robot, next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take the whole of that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good, I nearly heard that as just clearing it. Sensors as well, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sensors as well. That's what I've agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you check the guarding on the Palletiser on Friday? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes, I'll check the guarding on the Palletiser on Friday. Top priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, Friday still stands? Heard 'top priority' and thought you were bringing it forward.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, on Friday is still the timing. Top priority please, but I'm not changing the day.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine, that's clear. Palletiser guarding on Friday, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, could you also schedule downtime for the main isolation valve with production first thing tomorrow? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. I'm not available for the production discussion first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right. Grace Liu, can you take over scheduling downtime for the main isolation valve with production? First thing tomorrow, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that instead of Tomasz. I'll schedule downtime for the main isolation valve with production first thing tomorrow. Low priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just separating the two things in my head: first thing tomorrow is the scheduling, not an agreed valve outage?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Correct, it's scheduling downtime with production. We're not agreeing an outage time in this call.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Always the bit that catches people out—when the admin happens versus when the kit actually stops.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. And just to keep the urgency straight, the air dryer lock-out tag-out sign-off is the urgent one for today, Grace.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's clear. Air dryer sign-off today, urgent. The other two keep the timings we've just agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I've got the new starters' training records Monday, whenever I get a chance, then the Palletiser guarding on Friday, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mine are the boiler feed pump bearings Monday, fairly important, and the line 2 robot jam and sensors next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And no one's accidentally put me down to mend the coffee machine, have they? That was a complaint, not a heroic offer.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Definitely a complaint. Very clearly minuted in spirit only.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. All clear from production.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's everything agreed. Thanks, all. See you in a bit.
